name: pile
title: Pile
description: Several things shown as one, with the edges of the others under it.
use: A group collapsed to its first member: notifications of one kind, files sent together, drafts of one document. The pile holds one surface and draws two more behind it. The sheets under the top one are decoration, so say how many there are in words.

instead.when: The members are slides to step through

classes.name: pile
classes.description: The holder of the top surface: two sheets lie behind it, each 8px in on both sides and 6px lower than the one above

properties.name: --pile-radius
properties.description: The corner of the sheets under the top one; set it to the top surface's own corner

properties.name: --pile-step
properties.description: How far each sheet shows below the one above it

properties.name: --pile-inset
properties.description: How far each sheet is in from the one above it, on both sides
